**NeST Digital: Digital Practice Job Descriptions**

**Location:** Trivandrum (TVM)

**Software Engineer – Enterprise Web and Mobile Applications**

**Experience:** 3–5 Years

**Role Overview:** As a Software Engineer, you will build user-centric mobile applications from the ground up. Working closely with the Tech Lead and UX designers, you will develop pixel-perfect UIs and integrate complex backend APIs to deliver seamless mobile experiences.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain mobile applications with a focus on smooth UI/UX and high performance.
* Integrate third-party libraries, native modules, and backend RESTful APIs.
* Implement robust state management and secure offline data caching.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and fix performance bottlenecks and UI rendering issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and peer code reviews.
* Migration of Web applications to mobile applications

**Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Hands-on experience developing mobile apps using **[React Native OR Flutter]**.
* Proficiency in **[JavaScript/TypeScript OR Dart]**.
* Experience with mobile UI debugging tools, push notifications (Firebase/APNs), and deep linking.
* Familiarity with Git workflows and mobile testing frameworks (e.g., Detox, Appium, or Flutter Test).
* Preferrable to have full stack enterprise application experience with ReactJS or similar technologies,
